news.title: Final dividend of ₹10.00 announced
news.body: Shareholders will receive a dividend of ₹10.00. Ex-date: 7th August 2026 Payment date: 26th September 2026 Dividend yield will be 1.0%, which is higher than the industry average of 0.8%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is well covered by both earnings (28% earnings payout ratio) and cash flows (47% cash payout ratio). The dividend has increased by an average of 24% per year over the past 10 years. However, payments have been volatile during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 34% over the next 3 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹193 (up from ₹181 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹147.1b (up 14% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹23.0b (up 6.3% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 16% (down from 17% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Post-clinical trial products Pre-registration: 25 Launched (during full year): 11 Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 8.9%. Revenue is forecast to grow 10% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 11% growth forecast for the Pharmaceuticals industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 24% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 18% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.

news.title: Alkem Laboratories Limited Recommends Final Dividend for Financial Year Ended 31 March, 2026, Payable on and from 01 September, 2026
news.body: Alkem Laboratories Limited at its board of directors meeting held on May 28, 2026, recommended a final dividend of INR 10.00 per equity share of INR 2.00 each for financial year ended 31 March, 2026, for the approval of shareholders at the upcoming Annual General Meeting of the Company. news.title: Alkem Laboratories Limited Receives Certificate of GMP Compliance of a Manufacturer For Manufacturing Facility Located At Baddi, India from Department of Pharmacy (Human Medicines) – Germany
news.body: Alkem Laboratories Limited announced that Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 as amended ("SEBI LODR Regulations") and in furtherance to its earlier intimation dated 10th November 2025, captioned `EU GMP inspection by German Health Authority at Alkem's manufacturing facility located at Baddi, India', please be informed that the Company has received a `Certificate of GMP Compliance of a Manufacturer' from the Department of Pharmacy (Human Medicines) ­ Germany, following the inspection conducted from 04th November, 2025 to 10th November, 2025. The said certificate is valid for a period of 3 (three) years from the date of inspection.

news.title: Esperion Reaches Settlement Agreement with Alkem Laboratories Ltd.'s Fifth ANDA Filer Not to Market Generic Version of Nexletol (Bempedoic Acid) & Nexlizet (Bempedoic Acid & Ezetimibe) Prior to April 19, 2040
news.body: Esperion announced that it has entered into a settlement agreement with Alkem Laboratories Ltd. (Alkem). This agreement resolves the patent litigation brought by Esperion against Alkem in response to Alkem’s Abbreviated New Drug Applications (ANDAs) seeking approval to market generic versions of NEXLETOL and NEXLIZET prior to the expiration of the applicable patents. Pursuant to the agreement, Alkem has agreed not to market a generic version of either NEXLETOL or NEXLIZET in the United States prior to April 19, 2040, unless certain limited circumstances customarily included in these types of agreements occur. news.body: Axsome Therapeutics, Inc. announced that it has entered into a settlement agreement with Alkem Laboratories Ltd. news.title: Alkem Laboratories Limited Launches Renocia Cyclical Therapy, A Nutritional Supplements Kit, to Support Hair Growth
news.body: Alkem Laboratories Limited announced the launch of Renocia cyclical therapy kit, a scientifically-designed weekly nutritional supplementation regimen to support hair growth, strengthen hair follicles and manage hair loss. The supplements in the kit are made using only vegetarian-sourced ingredients. Renocia cyclical therapy kits contains a set of nutritional supplements, including vitamins, minerals, and amino acids, each to be taken on designated days of the week. This structured weekly protocol enables better nutrient absorption and utilisation. For convenience and better adherence, Renocia cyclical therapy Kit is available in a wallet pack containing nutritional supplements for four weeks with a clear description of which tablets need to be taken on each day of the week.
